message.jaymoskingdoms.ash_rot.unknown: The rot has not come to your hands yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ash_rot.no_foe: Nothing there for the rot to take.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ash_rot.no_wall: No wall close enough to rot through.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.hush_ward.de: The Lantern Warden's hush round you for half a minute: blows and shots stop just short of you, a point of stamina for each point of harm. Blasts get through.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.power.desc: For those with a power: its own moves hit harder, reach further where they are aimed, spread wider, and what they lay on others lasts longer.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.power.now: +%s%% harm from your power's moves, +%s%% reach when aimed and wider area moves, +%s%% longer on others
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.blocked.powerle: Only someone with a power can raise this.
key.jaymoskingdoms.combat_mode: Combat Mode (number keys fire forms and arts)
message.jaymoskingdoms.combat_mode.on: Combat mode: in stance, 1-5 fire your belt's forms. 6-9 are your art keys
message.jaymoskingdoms.combat_mode.off: Combat mode off: the number keys pick hotbar slots again
message.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.summons_re: The summons unfolds into a map. The court is marked on it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.court_move: Someone has built where the court was to stand. A new map is pressed into your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.summons_bl: The summons is blank here. Its court is in the Overworld.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.arrive.0: What woke in you was never yours to keep.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.arrive.1: The gift is forbidden. Kneel, and it ends quietly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.arrive.2: There. The one who shines. Take them.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.rally: Bind them! The Arbiter will judge what's left.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.sho: Your shots are known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.blu: Your fists are known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.bla: Your blade is known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.mag: That gift of yours is known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.learned.bea: Your beasts are known to me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cordon.overload: Too much... too much to hold!
stranger.jaymoskingdoms.name: %s, %s of %s
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.0: You carry it too. I can feel it from here. Show me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.1: I've walked a long way to find someone like you. Defend yourself!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.2: They say yours is strong. Let's see whose is stronger.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.call.3: No sense hiding it. Come on, then!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.yield.0: Enough! Enough. You've the better of it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.yield.1: I yield. I've more road to walk yet.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.yield.2: Well fought. I'll be stronger when we meet again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.won.1: Find me when you've grown into it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.intro.0: Well met. I'm %s. I've walked a long way to find someone who carries what I carry.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.intro.1: Hold there. %s, that's me. I felt your gift from the road.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.intro.2: My name's %s. Don't mind me, I only want to see what yours can do.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.back.0: You again. You walked off last time; I said I'd find you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.back.1: Remember me? I've thought of nothing else since you turned your back.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.back.2: Back again, and so am I. We've a fight to finish.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.ignored.0: Walk away, then. I'll find you again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.ignored.1: This isn't over. I'll be back.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.ignored.2: Not today? Another day, then. I'm patient.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.sleep.0: Sleep, then. I'll be right outside.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.sleep.1: I'll wait. I've waited longer for less.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.waited.0: %s hours I stood out here. Now, where were we?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.waited.1: You slept %s hours. I waited every one of them.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.waited.2: Rested? Good. %s hours I've had to think about this fight.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.good_figh: Up you get. That was a good fight.
Easy now. You fought well; I'll come find you again when you're stronger.
Good fight. No one should be left lying after one of those.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.finish.0: You should have stayed down the first time.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.finish.1: Weak. The world has no use for a gift like yours.
